Bar.Label: Character portraits
Bar.Reset: Back to the GM's default position
Bar.SetDefault: Use this position and size as the default for everyone
Bar.CompactOn: Compact mode: only who is speaking
Bar.ResetDone: Portrait bar back to the default position.
Bar.HiddenHint: Portrait bar hidden. To show it again: the token controls button, Alt+Shift+R or Settings.
Bar.DefaultSaved: Position and size saved as the default for players who never adjusted the bar.

Bridge.Lost: Talking Portraits: lost connection to the bot. Reconnecting…
Bridge.Disconnected: Discord bot disconnected (is the bot running?)

Toggle.Name: Show/hide the portrait bar
Toggle.Hint: Shows or hides the bar on this screen.

Reset.Name: Reset bar position
Reset.Hint: Moves the bar back to the GM's default position.

Lock.Name: Lock/unlock the bar
Lock.Hint: When unlocked, the bar can be dragged and resized.

Mapping.Name: Players, Discord and art
Mapping.Label: Configure
Mapping.Hint: Links each user to a Discord ID and a character, and picks art 1 and 2.

WsPort.Name: Bot port
WsPort.Hint: WebSocket port of the local bot (WS_PORT). Only the GM client, on the same machine, connects to it.

ShowGm.Name: GM card
ShowGm.Hint: When to show the GM card (or the selected NPC).

CardFilter.Name: Which players to show
CardFilter.Hint: Every player with a character, or only those with Foundry open.

ShowStats.Name: Show sheet data
ShowStats.Hint: HP, level, class and hero points on the cards.

FlipMs.Name: Art swap speed (ms)
FlipMs.Hint: Interval between art 1 and art 2 while speaking.

ReleaseMs.Name: Delay after speaking (ms)
ReleaseMs.Hint: Time before the portrait returns to rest, so it doesn't blink between words.

CombatMode.Name: During combat
CombatMode.Hint: What to do with the bar while a combat is running.

Hidden.Name: Hide the portrait bar
Hidden.Hint: This screen only. You can also use the token controls button or Alt+Shift+R.

IdleOpacity.Name: Opacity when nobody speaks
IdleOpacity.Hint: Bar transparency while nobody is speaking.

SingleArt.Name: Single-art animation
SingleArt.Hint: For characters with a single (static) art: what to do while they speak. The glow in the player's color is always shown.

HeroIcon.Name: Hero point icon
HeroIcon.Hint: Image used instead of circles. Empty = circles. Spent points are dimmed.

PortraitStyle.Name: Portrait style
PortraitStyle.Hint: Cutout: the art (transparent PNG) stands on the plate with no frame, stream-overlay style. Frame: the art sits inside a box.

FadeSilent.Name: Fade who isn't speaking
FadeSilent.Hint: The art of anyone not speaking is dimmed and returns to normal while they speak. The name/HP plate is unchanged.

SpeakingGlow.Name: Glow on who is speaking
SpeakingGlow.Hint: Outline in the player's color around the character while they speak.

Mapping.Title: Talking Portraits: players and art
Mapping.InChannel: Bot connected, in channel {channel}. Use this list to fill in the IDs.
Mapping.NoChannel: Bot connected but not in a voice channel. Join one (the bot follows) or use /entrar.
Mapping.BridgeOff: The bot is not connected to this Foundry. Open Ouvidor (or iniciar.bat) on this machine.
Mapping.PlayersHint: Call members without an ID here are ignored. Without a chosen actor, the user's character is used. With two arts, the portrait alternates between art 1 and art 2 while speaking; with one, it uses the animation chosen in the settings.
Mapping.DetectHint: Look for -closed/-open art (art 1/art 2) next to the character art
Mapping.DetectAllDone: Art found for {count} character(s). Check and save.
Mapping.DetectNone: No -closed/-open art found next to {name}'s art.
Mapping.DetectFound: Found art for {name}. Check and save.
Mapping.UseNpcHint: With an NPC token selected, the GM card shows that NPC.
Mapping.BadIds: Ignored invalid Discord IDs: {names}. An ID has 17 to 20 digits.
